item.title: Moral Distress, Burnout, and the Intensive Care Unit Environment.
item.description: This article examines the relationship between moral distress and burnout among intensive care unit (ICU) clinicians and argues that moral distress acts as a precursor to burnout. item.description: Hypernatremia is frequent in the intensive care unit (ICU) and is associated with adverse outcomes. We investigated global treatment preferences and clinicians' willingness to enroll patients in a randomized trial to inform its feasibility.
